hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.py"; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.py"; else echo "guard.py: no python interpreter found; blocking" >&2; exit 2; fi
if command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1; then powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/protect-env.ps1"; fi
